issues.description: Threshold constant used in the WHERE clause for task 'Aufgabe 07' is inconsistent: the problem statement requires selecting municipalities with mehr als 75,000 male or mehr als 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution SQL uses a threshold of 7,500 (einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500). This mismatch will produce different result sets and confuse students about the intended numeric criterion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Preferred: update solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to use 75000 in the WHERE clause (WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000). Alternatively, if the intended threshold is 7,500, update problem_statement.md to state 7,500 instead of 75,000.
